description: My website where you'll find all my latest projects and, also, a little bit about who I am.

hero.description: I’m Elías Pereyra, a Fullstack Developer focused on Web and Mobile Frontend development, with a strong focus on scalability, security, and UX.

synkpay.description: Owned the frontend development of a medium-sized cryptocurrency dashboard, working independently under the guidance of the Tech Lead. Led a large-scale refactor of the design system from Styled-components to Tailwind + CVA, and moved the codebase from a feature-based to a module-based architecture.

keywallet.description: Contributed to the frontend development of a cryptocurrency wallet as part of a small mobile frontend team of three engineers. I focused on user experience and application security: password and biometric authentication, session auto-lock, and re-authentication mechanisms.

octaflow.description: Octaflow is an AI-assisted engineering platform that enables companies to continue developing and maintaining software products through coordinated AI agents. Worked on the Profile component from the ground up, collaborating with another developer to build the infrastructure around project context, agent planning and execution, harnesses, and verification workflows that help produce complete development outcomes for clients.

contributions.title: Previous Contributions
contributions.author: Author:
contributions.first: I worked as a translator and technical content reviewer for freeCodeCamp en Español, on articles and handbooks about web development and programming. I translated more than 40 pieces of different lengths and complexity, from introductions to basic concepts to documentation on more specific technical topics.
contributions.second: My goal was to bring quality technical content to people who aren't fluent in English yet, or who simply prefer reading in Spanish. The idea was for everything the freeCodeCamp community builds in English to also reach the Spanish-speaking community.

about.title: About me
about.first: I’m Elías Pereyra Gómez, a developer from Argentina who enjoys turning ideas into things that actually work.
about.second: Most of my work revolves around web and mobile development, with a particular focus on frontend, UX, scalability, and security. I like understanding how the different pieces of an application fit together, not just the part that users see.
about.third: I also pay special attention to the UI: I like making it attractive and customizable, always grounded in the fundamentals of interface design.
about.fourth: And moving to the back, I also enjoy backend development, so I can build a complete system, end to end.

contact.title: Let's build something.
contact.subtitle: Open to fullstack and frontend roles.

turnos.first-paragraph: An appointment management system for patient consultations. You can sign up, enter your personal and medical information, and book an appointment. Then, you will receive an SMS notification if the doctor confirms the appointment or not.
turnos.second-paragraph: This type of system helps streamline the process of booking an appointment with a doctor. It saves waiting time for patients, provides basic information in advance, and speeds up the appointment management process for doctors and medical resources.
turnos.third-paragraph: The system is developed with Next.js and Appwrite (a BaaS - cloud-based service). The pages and components were designed in Figma.

workstart.first-paragraph: A platform for finding jobs with no experience required, covering various industries in Argentina. No registration is needed—simply select the job you like and send an email to the company.
workstart.second-paragraph: Applying directly to the company saves a lot of time and helps personalize the contact. Additionally, each job listing displays key details such as salary, work mode, schedule, responsibilities, and benefits. The platform is designed so that these details are mandatory for posting job openings.
workstart.third-paragraph: The system is developed with Next.js and WordPress as a CMS, communicating through a GraphQL API. The design of all pages and components was created in Penpot and Figma.
